item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:50 HKT 07/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the persistent influence of the northeast monsoon, the weather will be mainly fine over Guangdong in the next couple of days. A fresh easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week and over the weekend. An anticyclone aloft will cover the coast of southern China early next week. The weather will be generally fine over the region.
